description: Split a PDF into multiple PDFs by page ranges. Each range becomes one output file written into outputDir.

basename.description: Stem for output filenames. Default = source filename without .pdf. Final names look like '<basename>-1-3.pdf'.

outputDir.description: Directory to write outputs into. Defaults to the source PDF's directory.

path.description: Absolute path to the source PDF.

ranges.description: Page ranges to split into separate output PDFs, 1-based. Examples: ["1-3", "4-7", "8"] produces three files. Each range becomes one output PDF.

name: split
title: Split PDF
